dataList.title: Proceed Through 5F
dataList.description: We're on 5F. Let's keep heading inside.

dataList.title: Stop Buffet
dataList.description:
What awaited us on the 5F was Buffet, who hadn't engorged into the massive form they'd turned into before the Liquidation.

They want us to stay, but we can't. We need to defeat Buffet to keep moving forward.

dataList.title: Proceed Through 5F
dataList.description: Buffet, the Crimson God of Le Rouge, who was also our companion, Pwie... has gone still. We should proceed deeper into 5F.

dataList.title: Head to 6F
dataList.description:
The path to 6F opened after Meursault finished his meal.

Let's head up to 6F.
